en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European town square with a tall church dominating the scene. The church has a high tower with a clock and an onion-shaped spire topped by a cross. Surrounding it are multi‑story townhouses and shops lining a relatively empty street where an early automobile and a few pedestrians are visible. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.
